setup: A wave has envelope A(t) = [[a]] + [[b]] cos t, and the question asks for a feature of that envelope.

steps.say: The constant [[a]] sets the midline, and the cosine term swings [[b]] above and below it.
The cosine reaches 1 at its peak and -1 at its trough, so the envelope runs from [[a]] - [[b]] to [[a]] + [[b]].
The spread is the difference between those two extremes, which is twice [[b]].
